title: CNN grades ulcerative colitis inflammatory activity from confocal laser endomicroscopy
summary: A convolutional neural network automatic severity grading system for probe-based confocal laser endomicroscopy was developed retrospectively and then tested prospectively on image and video sets. Image sensitivities for grades A-D were 97.38%, 84.56%, 86.22% and 97.74%, video sensitivities 75.56%, 94.00%, 92.31% and 95.24%, and the quadratic weighted kappa versus pathology was 0.780; the endomicroscopy score also predicted relapse better than white-light endoscopy over at least 12 months.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network automatic severity grading system on endomicroscopy images
organization: Shandong University; Qilu Hospital of Shandong University

evidence.tested: Prospective image and video testing sets, pathology correlation and 12-month relapse follow-up.
evidence.unknown: Cohort sizes not read; single-study development and test; no outcome benefit shown; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A CNN graded inflammatory activity automatically from endomicroscopy images.
